name: Lisbon & Alfama
summary: Seven steep hills defeated by a century of funiculars, lifts, and rattling trams. Ride up, wander down, and let Alfama's alleys set the pace.
highlights: Tram 12E around Alfama at dawn — skip the 28E crowds
Early-evening fado sessions, no dinner obligation
Counter lunch at a tasca: grilled fish and vinho verde
